description.p: Nuvo plays your music from your own folders and from the streams you link to it. Your library, likes, play history and cache stay on your computer, encrypted, and nothing needs an account.

ul.li: Gapless playback with crossfade, an equalizer, normalization, speed and pitch
Synced lyrics, a karaoke view and your own lyrics
Recommendations worked out on your computer: mixes, radio and starter artists
Imports from links and from CSV, JSON and M3U files, exports of everything you keep
Local music folders with tags, covers and watching
Nine themes, a colour editor, fonts and ten interface languages

description.p: Nuvo stores its library key in the Secret Service keyring, such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet.

description.p: The first public version of Nuvo.

ul.li: The Rust daemon with an encrypted library, an encrypted audio cache and a recovery phrase
Gapless playback, crossfade, equalizer, normalization, speed, pitch, reverb, sleep timer and A-B loop
Synced lyrics, a karaoke view, your own lyrics, offsets and local translation
Local recommendations, imports from links and files, local music folders and exports
Nine themes, the colour editor, fonts, wallpaper and ten interface languages
